0022600116.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, first in the Northwest Division and second in the West) host the LA Clippers (1-0, first in the Pacific Division and first in the West) in the Thunder's third game of the 2026-27 season. Oklahoma City has won both its home and road games so far and is on a two-game winning streak, while Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery) are unavailable for the Thunder, and Bradley Beal (out, knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (out, shoulder surgery), Max Strus (out, foot plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out, foot surgery) are unavailable for the Clippers. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 128-110 regular-season win in Los Angeles on April 8, 2026.
